This time he was from GSquad under repair appointment. Ive made so many calls trying to fix this issue. No one cares. No one is listening. I give up. #DishpanhandsinVeroBeach

Sentence (English): I know that amazed is an often overused word, but I am quite literally amazed at the function of this dishwasher!
Comments (English): [ Spotless! ] || ---------------- || I know that amazed is an often overused word, but I am quite literally amazed at the functionality of this dishwasher! I thought our old dishwasher was fine, but we obviously I just didn't know what I was missing! I was used to having to have a rag in my hand when putting up dishes from my old one to either wipe away stray food particles, or finish drying the dishes. That is not something I have to do with this one, because every since dish, glass, fork and spoon comes out spotless and completely dry! I love how many different cycle selections it has, as well as sanitize, and drying options. As a canner, that sanitize function is super helpful. One of the best features of the machine though is the cool custom fit features. I adore the third rack on the top that allows me to place utensils, lids, and tiny measuring bowls in a place where they actually get clean, and don't end up flipped over and full of water. The utensil rack is super cool as well, and the pieces on top keep utensils seperated so they all get clean, and you can even place wine glasses in it so they are secure and don't get broken. I appreciate that it is quiet and Energy Star certified. I use to hate unloading the dishwasher because it meant rewashing several things it at least tidying up the dishes some, but those days are long gone! It even plays a little tune when it's finished!

Sentence (English): I had a Bosch 100 series from the previous generation that lasted just over a year before it died.
Comments (English): [ Not as good as previous generation ] || ---------------- || I had a Bosch 100 series from the previous generation that lasted just over a year before it died. The new 100 series seems very similar, but slightly worse than the last one in almost every way. While it seems to clean about as well as the old one, it is both significantly louder and takes significantly longer to run a cycle. There was also more customization available on the racks (tines could be folded flat) on the old one. The last generation indicated how much time remained on the unit itself; with this one, you have to look in the app. Speaking of which, why in the world does my dishwasher need to connect to the Internet? This "feature" is completely useless. Think about it - even if you wanted to start it with the app for some reason, you'd still have to add detergent and close the door, right? All the "advanced " settings that are only available on the app should really just be on the unit itself. Anyway, it's pretty close to the old one otherwise. It still ultimately cleans well, which is of course what really matters. But it seems like they've take some serious steps back in the name of "progress." Here's hoping this one at least lasts longer than a year.

Sentence (English): Overall, I am very satisfied with the Bosch Series 4 dishwasher.
Comments (English): [ Almost perfect – one small thing to note ] || ---------------- || Overall, I am very satisfied with the Bosch Series 4 dishwasher. The integration of the built-in device went smoothly and the cleaning performance is consistently impressive. The operation is intuitive and the various washing programs cover all everyday needs. Energy efficiency also seems to be a plus point of this model. However, there is one thing that bothers me a bit: the cutlery rail. It feels a bit wobbly when you take it off. This does not reduce the functionality of the dishwasher, but I would have expected a more stable design for a product of this quality. I would definitely recommend this device due to its many advantages, but would like to point out that the cutlery rail deserves a little more attention in the design. 4 out of 5 stars.
Comments (Original): [ Fast perfekt – eine Kleinigkeit zu beachten ] || ---------------- || Insgesamt bin ich mit dem Bosch Serie 4 Geschirrspüler sehr zufrieden. Die Einbaugerät Integration verlief problemlos und die Reinigungsleistung ist durchweg beeindruckend. Die Bedienung ist intuitiv und die verschiedenen Waschprogramme decken alle Bedürfnisse des Alltags ab. Energieeffizienz scheint ebenfalls ein Pluspunkt dieses Modells zu sein.Dennoch gibt es eine Sache, die mich etwas stört: Die Besteckschiene. Sie fühlt sich beim Ausziehen etwas wackelig an. Dies mindert zwar nicht die Funktionalität des Geschirrspülers, aber für ein Produkt dieser Qualität hätte ich eine stabilere Ausführung erwartet.Ich würde dieses Gerät aufgrund seiner vielen Vorteile definitiv empfehlen, möchte aber darauf hinweisen, dass die Besteckschiene etwas mehr Aufmerksamkeit in der Konstruktion verdient hätte. 4 von 5 Sternen.

Sentence (English): Functionally, this dishwasher is great, it gets the dishes clean and dry and that's what a dishwasher should do.
Comments (English): [ Great Dishwasher, horrible interface ] || ---------------- || Functionally, this dishwasher is great, it gets the dishes clean and dry and that's what a dishwasher should do. However, getting it to work is a different story. The touch interface is horrible! There is a delay between a press and the button becoming active. Many time you need to press more then once to get it going. But this is nothing compared to the need for an app to run some of the features of this dishwasher. If you do not have the app, or if for some reason you do not have internet connection, you can not run these features. For example, here in Califronia, the electricity rate during the day is outrageously expensive and most people are using a delayed start to run the cycle overnigh. For this model, Bosch decided to remove this option from the appliance and move it to an app. That leads to some really odd situations in which you stand in front of the appliance to insert the last dirty dish and than you need to reach to your phone open the app and run your cycle from there. Now, if you have issue with your internet service, you can not use this feature or any other features or settings that are available only on the app. What made Bosch made this decision I am not sure, but one thing I am sure of, this is stupid. I have asked Bosch to return my dishwasher and get last years model instead and they refused. NO MORE BOSCH FOR ME.

Comments (English): [ Errored 3 times in first 3 weeks ] || ---------------- || Pros: cleans well, with the exception of some of the silverware on the top rack. Very quiet. Cons: dries plastics, but not 100%, which is one reason we got this model. 3 rack design and spacing/arrangement of rack tines mean we can't fit as much in as our previous dishwasher; bottom rack does not fit tall items, nor does middle rack fit medium height items; half sized chopping boards fall through the bottom rack unless placed sideways. Expensive. Worst: We followed the instructions to scrape but not rinse dishes, which has been our previous dishwasher directions too. The dishwasher ran for a week then errored, so we pulled it out and followed the instructions to disconnect the hoses, 3 grains of rice fell out and the error cleared. It ran for another week, then errored but this time pulling it out and emptying hoses did not clear it so we followed instructions to scoop out the water and pull the impeller door and pulled out a few tiny lettuce scraps. That cleared the error and it ran for another week until it errored again and clearing the impeller door did not clear the error, so we called Bosch. They referred us to an appliance service who would not serve us since we didn't buy it from them. Called again and got a different service. Waited 1/2 a week (still doing our dishes in the sink with a brand new dishwasher sitting there getting funky), took time off work and the service came out and pulled a few little pieces of green out of the air trap and said this was a regular occurrence and that they get called out all the time on new appliances, doesn't matter the brand. I still don't understand why I've never experienced this with lower value dishwashers, nor why the filter at the bottom is only designed to catch glass as I was told by the service person, nor why the error cleared and then ran for a week, then errored again, then ran, then errored again. It is deemed not the fault of the dishwasher but the owner. Additionally, I was told I could void my warranty by following the instructional videos Bosch directed me to to clear the errors and that I should rinse everything before putting them in the dishwasher. How confusing - follow the appliance person's directions or the manufacturers? I would not buy this again. In fact, if returns were possible, this machine would already be gone. We are just waiting for the next error and the next call to the appliance service. Fingers crossed it doesn't go on this way.

Cons: dries plastics, but not 100%, which is one reason we got this model. 3 rack design and spacing/arrangement of rack tines mean we can't fit as much in as our previous dishwasher; bottom rack does not fit tall items, nor does middle rack fit medium height items; half sized chopping boards fall through the bottom rack unless placed sideways. Expensive. Worst: We followed the instructions to scrape but not rinse dishes, which has been our previous dishwasher directions too. The dishwasher ran for a week then errored, so we pulled it out and followed the instructions to disconnect the hoses, 3 grains of rice fell out and the error cleared. It ran for another week, then errored but this time pulling it out and emptying hoses did not clear it so we followed instructions to scoop out the water and pull the impeller door and pulled out a few tiny lettuce scraps. That cleared the error and it ran for another week until it errored again and clearing the impeller door did not clear the error, so we called Bosch. They referred us to an appliance service who would not serve us since we didn't buy it from them. Called again and got a different service. Waited 1/2 a week (still doing our dishes in the sink with a brand new dishwasher sitting there getting funky), took time off work and the service came out and pulled a few little pieces of green out of the air trap and said this was a regular occurrence and that they get called out all the time on new appliances, doesn't matter the brand. I still don't understand why I've never experienced this with lower value dishwashers, nor why the filter at the bottom is only designed to catch glass as I was told by the service person, nor why the error cleared and then ran for a week, then errored again, then ran, then errored again. It is deemed not the fault of the dishwasher but the owner. Additionally, I was told I could void my warranty by following the instructional videos Bosch directed me to to clear the errors and that I should rinse everything before putting them in the dishwasher. How confusing - follow the appliance person's directions or the manufacturers? I would not buy this again. In fact, if returns were possible, this machine would already be gone. We are just waiting for the next error and the next call to the appliance service. Fingers crossed it doesn't go on this way.

Sentence (English): We had this dishwasher installed about 5 weeks ago and overall, we have been pleased.
Comments (English): [ Overall Pleased ] || ---------------- || We had this dishwasher installed about 5 weeks ago and overall, we have been pleased. Pros - We like the efficiency of it as it uses about 3 gallons of water on the Express setting. It also only takes 30 minutes and overall does a good job getting dishes clean. For more soiled dishes/dishware, we would recommend either the Normal, or Heavy settings, but of course the time it takes to complete those cycles is longer and it uses more water and energy. Another pro is that it is VERY quiet, at least compared to our previous dishwasher. It's almost surprising that it's even working as it's so quiet. Cons - The jury is still out on the 3rd and upper rack for silverware. While it's a cool idea, it does not always clean the silverware completely and it also does not allow us to stack glasses on the 2nd (middle) rack. So, we have improvised by placing our glasses on the bottom rack, but we don't think that's the most efficient use of space. Another con is that so far, at the completion of the cycle, we have noticed a smell that smells like chemicals/plastic. We tried running a cycle using vinegar to help with this smell, but that did not seem to work as well as we had hoped. We don't know if it's normal at first to have the smell (kind of like a new car smell) and we are hoping it will dissipate in time. But, overall we feel that the pros outweigh the cons and we are hoping it will give us many years of efficient dishwashings.

Sentence (English): I have used several dishwashers in my life.
Comments (English): [ Look no further. Choose a different unit! ] || ---------------- || I have used several dishwashers in my life. This one was purchased because we previously had a Bosch for a custom panel and it was good. However, wow, this thing is terrible and awfully frustrating! Anybody involved in thinking this racking style is good should be doing something else. The person who designed the racks must either A) not use dishes, or B) use only plates and short heavy glasses. They probably wanted to claim some sort of energy savings number, but I am lucky to get half as many dishes loaded with prior units. So I have to do more loads, which uses more energy and time. Having all these tines at an angle, and having so many, means many dishes don't fit. So I can only place a couple items on a level, if at all. Also, I have to hope things don't flip upside down during the cycle. And then I have to run it again or wash by hand. Defeats the purpose of buying a dishwasher, doesn't it? Additionally, the spring on this one is so much stronger than the older unit I can't even support the door open slightly. And the children about get their fingers pinched by the door slamming on them. Absolutely terrible, Bosch. You need to fix your racking (and door) design and send a free set to every customer, along with an apology letter.

Sentence (English): This KitchenAid Dishwasher replaced an older KitchenAid dishwasher washer that was about 15 years old.
Comments (English): [ Cleans very well. ] || ---------------- || This KitchenAid Dishwasher replaced an older KitchenAid dishwasher washer that was about 15 years old. Both are very similar in design and layout.My biggest gripe is that my dishes just don't sit well. No matter how I place the plates and bowls, they either move or they lean over. They just don't stay where I put them. Large mixing bowls and pans don't fit well either. I had the same problem with the older model, but it had more adjustments to move the tines. I did look at the owner's manual to see if it had recommendations on dish placement, but it didn't. I did find some info online, but it really didn't help.(There were suggestions to take your dishes with you when out shopping for a new dishwasher, but I liked the dishwasher I liked and was not about to get new dishes to fit the new dishwasher.)I do like that the dishes still dry, mostly, when you turn off the heat dry option. I was very impressed with the ProWash cycle. I had two large casserole dishes, with baked on food that I did not take the time to hand scrub, that came out clean. Overall, I am happy with my purchase. Time will tell how well it holds up. (I did have to replace the bottom rack of the older dishwasher after about eight (8) years.) I would recommend this product.PROS:- It is very quiet.- Cleans well.- Turning off heat dry allows me to wash Tupperware in it. I put plastic on the middle and third racks and they come out clean with no heat damage.- Height adjustment of the second rack is a great feature.- The top (third) rack is great for plastic containers.- The top (third) rack has its own rotating jets.- Stainless steel inside.CONS:- The touch pad is on the top of the door and it is VERY sensitive. Just opening it, I am always hitting one of the buttons and having to press cancel. I wish they weren't as sensitive.- The racks (tines) are flimsier than the ones in my older KitchenAid model.- The bottom and middle racks have one dish adjustment each, which moves the tines. My older model had more.- Only came with two Stemware holders on one side, my older model had more and some on both sides of the middle rack.- No utensil caddy on the bottom rack. My older model had one.- The Express Wash cycle doesn't clean as well.- The cycles are long.- My dishes don't sit well on bottom and middle racks.- The top (third) rack has a section for silverware, but it's not deep enough for larger cooking utensils.

Sentence (English): Back in 2005, I found the 12-place setting built-in dishwasher in my new apartment to be extremely inconvenient.
Comments (English): [ It is very comfortable. ] || ---------------- || Back in 2005, I found the 12-place setting built-in dishwasher in my new apartment to be extremely inconvenient. Since then, I avoided using built-in dishwashers even when I moved to homes that did. Recently, however, many acquaintances recommended dishwashers, so I wondered if they were convenient these days. To suit my lifestyle, I opted for a 6-place setting instead of a built-in one, positioning it so I could put the dishes in immediately after washing. It is very convenient. It is great to be able to put the dishes in the dishwasher right after meals. Nowadays, products that combine detergent and rinse aid are available, making maintenance easy. I just toss the 6-place setting tablets onto the floor. An automatic door opening feature would be nice, but in my case, it isn't particularly inconvenient without it. I only leave it open if I remember. If I leave it open, most of the dishes dry. Since Coupang offers a 2-year warranty, I purchased it even though it is my first Midea product. Update: It is already mid-November. I am using it well. When the amount of food is small, it is fine to cut the 6-place setting tablet in half and wash it using the P6 cycle. I clean and maintain the dishwasher once a month, so there are no odors, which is great. April 25: I have been using it for over a year. I tend to use it once a day, and it is excellent. The ultimate in convenience. March 26: Lately, I have been using it 3 to 4 times a week. The performance is still great!

Sentence (English): Back in 2005, I found the 12-place setting built-in dishwasher in my new apartment to be extremely inconvenient.
Comments (English): [ It is very comfortable. ] || ---------------- || Back in 2005, I found the 12-place setting built-in dishwasher in my new apartment to be extremely inconvenient. Since then, I avoided using built-in dishwashers even when I moved to homes that did. Recently, however, many acquaintances recommended dishwashers, so I wondered if they were convenient these days. To suit my lifestyle, I opted for a 6-place setting instead of a built-in one, positioning it so I could put the dishes in immediately after washing. It is very convenient. It is great to be able to put the dishes in the dishwasher right after meals. Nowadays, products that combine detergent and rinse aid are available, making maintenance easy. I just toss the 6-place setting tablets onto the floor. An automatic door opening feature would be nice, but in my case, it isn't particularly inconvenient without it. I only leave it open if I remember. If I leave it open, most of the dishes dry. Since Coupang offers a 2-year warranty, I purchased it even though it is my first Midea product. Update: It is already mid-November. I am using it well. When the amount of food is small, it is fine to cut the 6-place setting tablet in half and wash it using the P6 cycle. I clean the dishwasher once a month, so there are no odors, which is great. April 25: I've been using it for over a year. I tend to use it once a day, and it's fantastic. The ultimate in convenience. April 26: Lately, I've been using it 3 to 4 times a week. The performance is still excellent!

However, after the baby was born, the number of baby bottles increased, and doing the dishes while watching the baby became incredibly stressful. In particular, since I enjoy grilling meat and cooking at home, there is so much grease that I wonder how many times I have to use dish soap just to wash it off. I was getting stressed out and even told my husband, "You can just eat, but I'm busy because I have to watch the baby, do the dishes, and feed them right away!" So, when he suggested we just buy a dishwasher, I thought about it a lot before finally buying it, and I am satisfied. -*-Product Features-*-. First of all, although it is a 6-place setting model, it seems suitable for a family of about 2 to 3 people. I had ordered other products because they said they could install them without needing a hole, but Samsung said that wasn't possible. So I returned it, asked the landlord again, and then ordered it! I was able to choose the date I wanted, and the installer was very kind. -*-What this product is good about compared to others-*-. The day it arrived was my housewarming party, so I grilled pork belly, fried food, made japchae... there were tons of dishes to wash, but my stress was reduced by more than half. But this time, I just put them in, set the timer, went to sleep, and when I woke up, the lid was fully open, ventilation was good, and the dishes were sparkling! Washing dishes is really fine, but washing dishes while watching the baby is a whole different task. . Personally, I have a dryer, food waste disposer, and washing machine, but since getting the dishwasher, I feel like the housework in our house is finally finished. **This has been my genuine review. Sentence (English): Good quality for a great price.
Comments (English): [ My second LG in a row. ] || ---------------- || Good quality for a great price. Sentence (English): Purchase and installation was great but setting up dishwasher with Home Connect app was a problem.
Comments (English): [ WIFI Connection Problem ] || ---------------- || Purchase and installation was great but setting up dishwasher with Home Connect app was a problem. First, downloading app from Apple Store showed two apps (Home Connect and Bosch Home Connect)); since I has a Bosch dishwasher, I downloaded the Bosch Home Connect app but then learned it was not for dishwashers and had to uninstall and get the other app. Second, I followed instructions but was unable to connect dishwasher to WIFI. Third, called Bosch Support who was unable to help connect to WIFI and emailed a list of 4 Bosh Service Companies. One company advised the did not fix WIFI problems. Another advised I was not in their service area. Another advised I would have to get agreement from Bosch to pay for extra travel time for them to come to my place; they also indicated they had no one experienced with fixing WIFI problems. I left a message with the last company, but they never called me back. I called Bosch Support back and this time agent Marty fixed the WIFI problem. I was disappointed the instructions I had did not include the WIFI troubleshooting instructions that the agent apparently used to get the WIFI system to work.

Great feature!

Sentence (English): I love the dishwasher.
Comments (English): [ This review is for the installation service ] || ---------------- || I love the dishwasher. It is quiet and cleans well. It is not the latest revision of the Bosch 800 but the core technology is the same. The racks are slightly different but they do the job. Now to the installer. Costco please get better local installers. They need better vetting! Two guys showed up to my house not on the scheduled appointment. There was no prior communication that they were coming. So I was surprised. Anyway I was available and needed the dishwasher to be working so I let them in to do the work. One guy did most of the work while the other just stood there playing on his phone the entire time. They did a terrible job. After discovering extra screws and parts from the installation, I went over the instructions manual and found out the unit was not installed properly in multiple ways. Thanks to the guy using his channel lock wrench to adjust the plastic feet to level the unit, both plastic levels are all damaged. The dishwasher came with a tool designed for this and they were too lazy to use the proper tool. They also did not use the brackets to secure the unit and instead just put two screws to my cabinets without any spacers. And lastly they didn't even install the front panel, it just fell off when I touched it. In summary: the Bosch dishwasher is great. It has been over a month now. Still happy with it. The installer is absolutely horrendous. No communication, no proper training. Damaged the unit

Sentence (English): The 12-person dishwasher I was using was broken, so I ordered a model with an automatic door opening and a 3-stage cutlery holder after considering it for a long time, but the installer said that the joints on the top of my sink would be upset if I tried a model with a door opening, so I canceled the order. , (
Comments (English): The 12-person dishwasher I was using was broken, so I ordered a model with an automatic door opening and a 3-stage cutlery holder after considering it for a long time, but the installer said that the joints on the top of my sink would be upset if I tried a model with a door opening, so I canceled the order. , (If I move the cabinet, the sink and dishwasher will move away and the dishes will fall on the floor, which will be very annoying.) I gave up on the automatic door opening and searched quickly. There was a big discount with a credit card at Today's House, so I ordered it late in the afternoon on Friday and it arrived at 1 o'clock on Saturday. He came and installed it. I liked it because it was stainless steel and went well with the sink in my house. It's the same as the existing one, so there's no major inconvenience. I was concerned about the long cleaning time. So, I called LG to inquire and they told me that the standard electricity bill for one company was around 98 won, so I thought I could run the dishwasher with peace of mind. Anyway, it would have been nice to have a dishwasher with an automatic door opening and a 3-stage basket, but I was taken aback by the unexpected request for construction. I think I made a good choice with this model at an affordable price. Rather, Jo~~

Sentence (English): The brand KitchenAid implies quality and smart design, but…oops…Whirlpool bought it and brought it down to its own mediocre standards.
Comments (English): The brand KitchenAid implies quality and smart design, but…oops…Whirlpool bought it and brought it down to its own mediocre standards. It's quiet, so it gets some credit, but the interior design is just plain stupid, and you can't fix stupid. It holds so many fewer dishes than the Bosch it replaced, and while quiet, the Bosch had a better designed way of reducing sound. The 3rd rack for silverware, which was terrific with the Bosch, feels like it was designed by a child—and not a bright one at that. We bought it on sale, and still it is overpriced. Delivery was great, but I'm rating the product here.

Installation day. -A driver has arrived. The photo was taken with the driver's consent. One month has passed since installation. - As soon as I installed it, I put 1kg of salt and the correct amount of water I had purchased in advance into the water softener and stirred it with wooden chopsticks. - Before the first operation, we sterilized the container using vinegar. - I've run it 10 times so far, and although I used frog detergent, there were some scales, which are a component of tap water. - We recommend using rinse aid whenever possible. After using the rinse, the scale has definitely decreased. - The standard course is a 55-minute course, but the door opens automatically a few minutes before the end and it dries sufficiently even without hot air drying. - It seems to clean well enough even without the TrueSteam function. - The cutlery container has enough storage for cutlery and chopsticks, but if I buy it next time, if it's about 100,000 won, I think I'll buy it with 3 tiers so that I can put cutlery, chopsticks, and utensils on the top. - Among the recent models are Hot Air Drying - If you are not in a hurry, put it in your shopping cart and purchase it when the price drops. - I regret not buying her late, as she is called my 3rd great aunt. I will use it well. Thank you^^

Comments (English): [ #Photo review event. Raising elementary school children ] || ---------------- || #Photo review event. I bought this after suffering from endless dishwashing while raising three elementary school children. I had been putting it off for a while because I thought it would be cleaner to wash it with my hands and because of the high cost, but as dishwashing time, water bills, and hot water bills increased, I bought it because I was told that it would save me money and was tiring me out. As this was my first purchase, I couldn't buy an expensive product, so I bought it during a live broadcast at a reasonable price. I had the courage to purchase it for around 600,000 won.^^. As soon as I purchased it, I made a reservation for Saturday for the earliest possible date and had the technician install it right away. Since I am a tenant, I had to remove the existing dishwasher, but my husband removed it because he said it would cost 30,000 won. It's not that difficult to remove, so if you watch the video, you'll be able to do it. Don't forget to close the water valve! ^^. First of all, despite the discounted price, the exterior is so great that you don't feel like it at all. The latest product has an operation button on the top of the door, but this product has it on the front. It's not uncomfortable at all. After using it for a week, I am experiencing heaven. Since the kids are on vacation, I collect the dishes for breakfast, lunch, and dinner and wash them in the evening. After 2 hours and 10 minutes, the door automatically opens and dries. Anything you want to add in the middle can be added as soon as you open the door. I am very satisfied that I am able to give energy to my children during dishwashing time, which gives me both stamina and time. This product does not have a separate shelf for cutlery, so I put it in the container, but I am not sure if it is cleaned well. It looks clean to the naked eye. It's easy to use, and previous operations are saved, so only the power and start buttons are used. It has enough dishwashing capacity for 3 meals for a family of 5. If you go through live shopping like me, you can get discounts and even detergents, so it would be better if you buy it during an event. If you are hesitant like me, I hope you buy it ^^

I bought this after suffering from endless dishwashing while raising three elementary school children. I had been putting it off for a while because I thought it would be cleaner to wash it with my hands and because of the high cost, but as dishwashing time, water bills, and hot water bills increased, I bought it because I was told that it would save me money and was tiring me out. As this was my first purchase, I couldn't buy an expensive product, so I bought it during a live broadcast at a reasonable price. I had the courage to purchase it for around 600,000 won.^^. As soon as I purchased it, I made a reservation for Saturday for the earliest possible date and had the technician install it right away. Since I am a tenant, I had to remove the existing dishwasher, but my husband removed it because he said it would cost 30,000 won. It's not that difficult to remove, so if you watch the video, you'll be able to do it. Don't forget to close the water valve! ^^. First of all, despite the discounted price, the exterior is so great that you don't feel like it at all. The latest product has an operation button on the top of the door, but this product has it on the front. It's not uncomfortable at all. After using it for a week, I am experiencing heaven. Since the kids are on vacation, I collect the dishes for breakfast, lunch, and dinner and wash them in the evening. After 2 hours and 10 minutes, the door automatically opens and dries. Anything you want to add in the middle can be added as soon as you open the door. I am very satisfied that I am able to give energy to my children during dishwashing time, which gives me both stamina and time. This product does not have a separate shelf for cutlery, so I put it in the container, but I am not sure if it is cleaned well. It looks clean to the naked eye. It's easy to use, and previous operations are saved, so only the power and start buttons are used. It has enough dishwashing capacity for 3 meals for a family of 5. If you go through live shopping like me, you can get discounts and even detergents, so it would be better if you buy it during an event. If you are hesitant like me, I hope you buy it ^^

Sentence (English): This Bosch 800 series dishwasher is very quiet.
Comments (English): [ Quiet, sturdy, and performs well. ] || ---------------- || This Bosch 800 series dishwasher is very quiet. It's not silent, but not nearly as noisy as our previous dishwasher, which was a Whirlpool WDF510PAYS. It is also much more rigid/sturdy. The Whirlpool was anchored with the same method as this Bosch (two straps screwed into the underside of the countertop), but the Whirlpool easily shifted around so that sometimes the door would hit a drawer handle next to the dishwasher, and sometimes it could clear by 1/2". The Bosch does not move at all. The light showing that the dishwasher is active is a nice feature. I've encountered other Bosch dishwashers without the indicator, and have opened them to discover that they were still running (probably the dry cycle, but still. ). The CrystalDry feature is extremely effective. Dislikes: that it's not documented how to turn off the WiFi connection. The trick is that in order for the control to shut off WiFi to be accessible, the dishwasher has to be set in the "remote start anytime" mode, or at least not in the "monitor only" mode. It's also not documented how to change the customization settings using the control panel, only how to do it from the WiFi app.

Sentence (English): We bought this dishwasher new almost 9 years ago when we had twins.
Comments (English): [ When it works it works well ] || ---------------- || We bought this dishwasher new almost 9 years ago when we had twins. We wanted the bottle wash option due to the high number of bottles we would be washing. It was a great feature as well as the sanitary wash setting. We where also very suprised at how quiet this unit is. This model chugged along nicely for about 4 years without incident. The first ever problem I has was the heater element thermal fuse tripped and I had to reset it to get the dishwasher to get up to temp. That was it for about another 3 years. In the past 2 years I have had to replace the touch panel control board 2 times. The second one was only 3 months later. I've had to power cycle the breaker 2 times to get the silly thing to be responsive. I've also had to replace the circulation pump. I'm not blaming the unit 100% I found a small piece of plastic from a candy cane wrapper in the impeller, it was small but wedged in. I've also had pop corn kernels get past the screens and stop the pump on several occasions. I know that there is something else I'm forgetting but my most recent problem was today 2/26/2024 the door latch switch went out. At least this will be a simple fix. most of these fixes are easy enough to do if you are handy capable and can troubleshoot the problem but my goodness these things use to last decades before a single problem. none the less I love how quiet this unit is and that it does a great job cleaning dishes. If yours isn't cleaning than try loading it differently, use another soap or its got a problem like a clogged screen or pump. The one wish I had gotten for this unit was the optional 3rd rack on top for many units but sadly I cannot find a 3rd rack for this model.

A few other features include leak detection, four bottle jets, and dedicated wash zones. If you want to run half a load, you can create a wash zone to only wash the upper or lower rack. I also wanted to note that while every dinnerware set is different in size and shape, this actually fits our stuff, whereas the previous two we have owned have required creative placement to get certain dishes/cups to fit. At the end of the day, I feel this dishwasher is a great investment. It looks nice, it is quiet, and the customization of both the cycle options and the dishwasher rack layout provide everything needed to keep family meals running smoothly. With the addition of it being wi-fi, smart enabled, this is a no-brainer for this busy mom.

Sentence (English): #Photo review event.
Comments (English): #Photo review event. I bought it after suffering from endless dishwashing while raising three elementary school children. I thought it would be cleaner if I washed it myself and because of the high cost, but as the dishwashing time and water and hot water bills increased, I got tired and bought it because I heard it would save money. Since it was my first purchase, I couldn't buy an expensive product, so I bought it during a live broadcast at a reasonable price. I gained the courage to buy it at a price of 600,000 won. ^^. As soon as I bought it, I made a reservation for the earliest date, Saturday, and the technician contacted me to install it right away. Since I was a tenant, I had to remove the existing dishwasher as it was, but my husband took it off because they said it would cost 30,000 won. It's not that difficult to remove, so if you look for a video, you'll be able to do it. Don't forget to turn off the water valve! ^^. First of all, despite the discounted price, the appearance is so great that it doesn't feel like that at all. The latest product has an operation button on the top of the door, but this product is on the front. It's not inconvenient at all. After using it for a week, I'm experiencing heaven. The kids are on vacation, so I put the morning, lunch, and dinner dishes together and run them in the evening. After 2 hours and 10 minutes, the door opens automatically and they dry. If you want to add something in the middle, just open the door and it will stop. I am very satisfied because I can give my kids energy while washing dishes, so I gain both energy and time. This product does not have a separate spoon rack, so I put it in the container, but I am not sure if it will be washed well. It looks clean to the naked eye. It is easy to use, and the previous operation is saved, so I only use the power and start buttons. The capacity for washing dishes for 3 meals for a family of 5 is enough. If you do live shopping like me, you can get a discount and detergent, so it would be better to buy it when there is an event. I hope those who are hesitating like me will definitely buy it^^
Comments (Original): #포토리뷰이벤트초등 아이셋 키우며 끝없는 설거지에 시달리다 구입했습니다. 내 손으로 닦는게 깨끗하겠지하는 생각과 비싼 비용으로 그동안 미뤄왔는데 점점 길어지는 설거지 시간과 수도료, 급탕비등이 늘어나다보니 몸도 지치고 비용도 아껴준다는 말에 구입했습니다. 처음 구입이라 비싼제품은 사지 못하고 합리적인 가격으로 라이브방송때 구매하였습니다. 60만원대의 가격에 구매할수 있는 용기가 났네요.^^구입하자마자 제일빠른 날짜로 바로 토요일 예약하였고 기사님 연락으로 바로 설치하였습니다. 세입자다보니 기존 식기세척기를 그대로 빼놓아야했는데 3만원 비용 발생한다고 해서 신랑이 탈거했어요. 탈거 그렇게 어렵지 않으니 영상 찾아보시면 할수 있으실거에요. 수도밸브 잠그는거 잊지마세요!^^일단 할인된 금액임에도 불구하고 외관은 전혀 그렇게 느껴지지않을만큼 훌륭합니다. 최신제품은 문위쪽에 작동버튼이 있는데 이 제품은 앞면에 있어요. 전혀 불편하지 않습니다. 일주일 사용해본 결과 천국을 경험하고 있어요.아이들 방학이라 아침,점심,저녁 설거지 모아놓고 저녁에 돌리는데 2시간 10분후면 자동으로 문열리며 건조됩니다. 중간에 추가할것은 바로 문열면 정지되어 추가 가능하구요. 설거지 시간에 아이들에게 에너지를 줄수 있다니 체력과 시간 둘다 얻게되어 무척 만족합니다. 이제품은 수저선반이 따로 없어 통속에 넣는데 잘 세척되는지 모르겠어요.육안으로 깨끗해보입니다.사용방법도 간편하고 이전 동작이 저장되어 전원과 시작버튼 두개만 사용하고 있습니다.5가족 3끼 설거지 용량도 충분하네요. 저처럼 라이브쇼핑을 통하시면 할인에 세제까지 받을수 있으니 행사 있을때 구매하시면 더 좋을것 같아요.저처럼 망설이는 분들 꼭 구매하시길 바랍니다^^

The kitchen is narrow. - Because the kitchen is narrow, it was difficult to put 6 people on the sink. - I live alone, so I asked myself a lot about whether I really need more than 12 people. But I couldn't ignore the value of dishwashing time. - Among the built-in products, I chose LG, which I trust, for home appliances after considering it comprehensively compared to other large companies. - I searched "LG Objet Dishwasher Model Name Explanation" on a portal site and studied the model names. - As a one-person household, I didn't necessarily need hot air drying, True Steam, and storage space up to 3 levels. - After studying, DUBJ1EP was a reasonable choice for me. - All the home appliances are LG, and it was good because it was an officially certified store that I could trust for installation and after-sales service. - I live in Busan, so I applied for delivery on January 13th (Sat) and the technician visited on January 15th (Mon). 2. Installation day. - One technician came. I took pictures with the permission of the technician. He said that I could show my face. - The installation cost was free when installed in a standard cabinet. - I had never used the oven in the 7 years since I moved into the house, and since the oven space was standard, I wanted to install it there. - I thought I could separate the oven and the drawer below and remove it, but I didn't know that the standard cabinet would be removed as a whole. - I am keeping the standard cabinet and oven separately so that I can restore it to its original state when I move. - I regret that I should have installed the dishwasher earlier if I knew this would happen. - Next, I leveled the dishwasher and connected the water pipe under the sink. - I told him to contact me if water leaked from the water pipe, but it didn't happen for 3 weeks. - He gave me a simple explanation and instructions on how to use it. - The LG technician was very kind. 3. One month after installation. - As soon as I installed it, I put 1kg of salt and the amount of water that I had purchased in advance into a water softener and stirred it with wooden chopsticks. - I used vinegar to sterilize the entire unit before the first operation. - I've used it 10 times so far, and although I used frog detergent, there were still some water stains from tap water. - I recommend using a rinse if possible. The water stains have definitely decreased since I used a rinse. - The standard course is a 55-minute course, but the door opens automatically a few minutes before the end, and it dries well enough even without the hot air drying function. - It seems to clean well enough even without the true steam function. - There is enough storage for spoons and chopsticks in the spoon holder, but if I buy it again, I think I'll buy a 3-tier model that can hold spoons and chopsticks on the top if there's a difference of about 100,000 won. - It's a reasonable model with all the basic functions, although it's not a hot air drying model, true steam model, or a 2-tier shelf among the latest models. - If you're not in a hurry, put it in your cart and buy it when the price drops. - I regret buying it late because I don't know why it's called the 3rd generation aunt. I'll use it well. Thank you^^
Comments (Original): *1월13일 구매후 10번 작동후 쓰는 후기입니다.1. 구입전 상황- 1인 남성 가구입니다. 주방이 좁습니다. - 주방이 좁은 관계로 6인용을 싱크대에 올리기에는 무리가 있었습니다.- 혼자사는데 굳이 12인 이상이 필요한가에 자문을 많이 했지만  설거지하는 시간의 가치를 무시할 순 없었습니다.- 빌트인 제품 중 다른 대기업보다 종합적으로 고려해서 가전은 역시 믿음의 LG를 선택했습니다.-  포털사이트에 'LG 오브제 식기세척기 모델명 풀어보기'를 검색 후 모델명을 공부했습니다.- 1인가구로 굳이 열풍건조, 트루스팀, 수납공간이 3단까지는 필요없었습니다.- 공부를 해보니 DUBJ1EP가 저에겐 합리적 선택이었습니다.- 집에 가전은 모두 LG인데 설치 및 사후관리 부분에서도 믿음이 가는 공식인증점이라서 좋았습니다.- 부산인데 1/13(토) 배송을 신청했고 1/15(월) 기사님이 방문하셨습니다.2. 설치하는 날 -기사님1분이 오셨습니다. 기사님의 동의를 얻어 사진촬영을 하였습니다. 얼굴이 나와도 된다고 하더군요.-규격장 자리에 설치시 설치비용은 무료였습니다.-집에 오븐을 입주후 7년동안 한번도 쓰지않았고 오븐자리만 규격장이라 거기에 설치하려했습니다.-오븐 및 밑에 서랍장을 분리해서 탈거할 줄 알았는데 규격장 통째로 탈거될지 몰랐습니다.-자가지만 차후 이사시 원상복귀해줄려고 규격장 및 오븐은 따로 보관중입니다.-이럴줄 알았으면 진작 식기세척기를 설치했어야 했는데 라는 아쉬움이 남았습니다.-그 다음 식기세척기 수평을 맞추고 싱크대 아래의 급수관을 연결했습니다.-차후 급수관에서 물이 새면 연락해라고 했는데 3주동안 그런 일은 없었습니다.- 간단한 설명 및 조작방법을 알려주셨습니다.- LG기사님은 상당히 친절하셨습니다.3. 설치후 한달 경과- 설치하자마자 미리 사다 놓은 소금1kg+물 정량을 연수통에 넣고 나무젓가락으로 저어줬습니다.- 첫 가동전 식초를 활용하여 통살균 작업을 했습니다.- 이제까지 10번 가동을 하였는데 세재는 개구리 세제를 썻지만 수돗물 성분인 물때가 쫌 있었습니다.- 가급적 린스는 쓰는 것을 추천합니다. 린스를 쓰니 확실히 물때가 줄었습니다.- 표준코스가 55분코스인데 종료 몇분전부터 문이 자동으로 열리고 열풍건조 없어도 충분히 잘말라있더군요.- 트루스팀기능 없이도 충분히 세척도 잘되는 것 같습니다.- 수저통에 수저 및 젓가락 수납은 충분한데 다음에 산다면 10만원 차이 정도라면 최상단에 수저 및 젓가락 식기구를 올릴 수 있는 3단으로 살 것 같습니다.- 최근모델 중 열풍건조X, 트루스팀X, 2단선반이지만 기본적인 기능은 다 갖춘 합리적인 모델인 것 같습니다.- 급하지 않으시다면 장바구니에 넣어두시다가 가격이 떨어지시면 구매하시길 바랍니다.- 왜 3대 이모님이라고 불리는지 늦게 산게 후회되네요. 잘쓰겠습니다. 감사합니다^^

Comments (English): *This is a review written after using it 10 times since purchasing it on January 13th. 1. Before purchase. - It is a one-person household. The kitchen is narrow. - Because the kitchen is narrow, it was difficult to put 6 people on the sink. - I live alone, so I asked myself a lot about whether I really need more than 12 people. But I couldn't ignore the value of dishwashing time. - Among the built-in products, I chose LG, which I trust, for home appliances after considering it comprehensively compared to other large companies. - I searched "LG Objet Dishwasher Model Name Explanation" on a portal site and studied the model names. - As a one-person household, I didn't necessarily need hot air drying, True Steam, and storage space up to 3 levels. - After studying, DUBJ1EP was a reasonable choice for me. - All the home appliances are LG, and it was good because it was an officially certified store that I could trust for installation and after-sales service. - I live in Busan, so I applied for delivery on January 13th (Sat) and the technician visited on January 15th (Mon). 2. Installation day. - One technician came. I took pictures with the permission of the technician. He said that I could show my face. - The installation cost was free when installed in a standard cabinet. - I had never used the oven in the 7 years since I moved into the house, and since the oven space was standard, I wanted to install it there. - I thought I could separate the oven and the drawer below and remove it, but I didn't know that the standard cabinet would be removed as a whole. - I am keeping the standard cabinet and oven separately so that I can restore it to its original state when I move. - I regret that I should have installed the dishwasher earlier if I knew this would happen. - Next, I leveled the dishwasher and connected the water pipe under the sink. - I told him to contact me if water leaked from the water pipe, but it didn't happen for 3 weeks. - He gave me a simple explanation and instructions on how to use it. - The LG technician was very kind. 3. One month after installation. - As soon as I installed it, I put 1kg of salt and the amount of water that I had purchased in advance into a water softener and stirred it with wooden chopsticks. - I used vinegar to sterilize the entire unit before the first operation. - I've used it 10 times so far, and although I used frog detergent, there were still some water stains from tap water. - I recommend using a rinse if possible. The water stains have definitely decreased since I used a rinse. - The standard course is a 55-minute course, but the door opens automatically a few minutes before the end, and it dries well enough even without the hot air drying function. - It seems to clean well enough even without the true steam function. - There is enough storage for spoons and chopsticks in the spoon holder, but if I buy it again, I think I'll buy a 3-tier model that can hold spoons and chopsticks on the top if there's a difference of about 100,000 won. - It's a reasonable model with all the basic functions, although it's not a hot air drying model, true steam model, or a 2-tier shelf among the latest models. - If you're not in a hurry, put it in your cart and buy it when the price drops. - I regret buying it late because I don't know why it's called the 3rd generation aunt. I'll use it well. Thank you^^

But I couldn't ignore the value of dishwashing time. - Among the built-in products, I chose LG, which I trust, for home appliances after considering it comprehensively compared to other large companies. - I searched "LG Objet Dishwasher Model Name Explanation" on a portal site and studied the model names. - As a one-person household, I didn't necessarily need hot air drying, True Steam, and storage space up to 3 levels. - After studying, DUBJ1EP was a reasonable choice for me. - All the home appliances are LG, and it was good because it was an officially certified store that I could trust for installation and after-sales service. - I live in Busan, so I applied for delivery on January 13th (Sat) and the technician visited on January 15th (Mon). 2. Installation day. - One technician came. I took pictures with the permission of the technician. He said that I could show my face. - The installation cost was free when installed in a standard cabinet. - I had never used the oven in the 7 years since I moved into the house, and since the oven space was standard, I wanted to install it there. - I thought I could separate the oven and the drawer below and remove it, but I didn't know that the standard cabinet would be removed as a whole. - I am keeping the standard cabinet and oven separately so that I can restore it to its original state when I move. - I regret that I should have installed the dishwasher earlier if I knew this would happen. - Next, I leveled the dishwasher and connected the water pipe under the sink. - I told him to contact me if water leaked from the water pipe, but it didn't happen for 3 weeks. - He gave me a simple explanation and instructions on how to use it. - The LG technician was very kind. 3. One month after installation. - As soon as I installed it, I put 1kg of salt and the amount of water that I had purchased in advance into a water softener and stirred it with wooden chopsticks. - I used vinegar to sterilize the entire unit before the first operation. - I've used it 10 times so far, and although I used frog detergent, there were still some water stains from tap water. - I recommend using a rinse if possible. The water stains have definitely decreased since I used a rinse. - The standard course is a 55-minute course, but the door opens automatically a few minutes before the end, and it dries well enough even without the hot air drying function. - It seems to clean well enough even without the true steam function. - There is enough storage for spoons and chopsticks in the spoon holder, but if I buy it again, I think I'll buy a 3-tier model that can hold spoons and chopsticks on the top if there's a difference of about 100,000 won. - It's a reasonable model with all the basic functions, although it's not a hot air drying model, true steam model, or a 2-tier shelf among the latest models. - If you're not in a hurry, put it in your cart and buy it when the price drops. - I regret buying it late because I don't know why it's called the 3rd generation aunt. I'll use it well. Thank you^^
Comments (Original): *1월13일 구매후 10번 작동후 쓰는 후기입니다.1. 구입전 상황- 1인 남성 가구입니다. 주방이 좁습니다. - 주방이 좁은 관계로 6인용을 싱크대에 올리기에는 무리가 있었습니다.- 혼자사는데 굳이 12인 이상이 필요한가에 자문을 많이 했지만  설거지하는 시간의 가치를 무시할 순 없었습니다.- 빌트인 제품 중 다른 대기업보다 종합적으로 고려해서 가전은 역시 믿음의 LG를 선택했습니다.-  포털사이트에 'LG 오브제 식기세척기 모델명 풀어보기'를 검색 후 모델명을 공부했습니다.- 1인가구로 굳이 열풍건조, 트루스팀, 수납공간이 3단까지는 필요없었습니다.- 공부를 해보니 DUBJ1EP가 저에겐 합리적 선택이었습니다.- 집에 가전은 모두 LG인데 설치 및 사후관리 부분에서도 믿음이 가는 공식인증점이라서 좋았습니다.- 부산인데 1/13(토) 배송을 신청했고 1/15(월) 기사님이 방문하셨습니다.2. 설치하는 날 -기사님1분이 오셨습니다. 기사님의 동의를 얻어 사진촬영을 하였습니다. 얼굴이 나와도 된다고 하더군요.-규격장 자리에 설치시 설치비용은 무료였습니다.-집에 오븐을 입주후 7년동안 한번도 쓰지않았고 오븐자리만 규격장이라 거기에 설치하려했습니다.-오븐 및 밑에 서랍장을 분리해서 탈거할 줄 알았는데 규격장 통째로 탈거될지 몰랐습니다.-자가지만 차후 이사시 원상복귀해줄려고 규격장 및 오븐은 따로 보관중입니다.-이럴줄 알았으면 진작 식기세척기를 설치했어야 했는데 라는 아쉬움이 남았습니다.-그 다음 식기세척기 수평을 맞추고 싱크대 아래의 급수관을 연결했습니다.-차후 급수관에서 물이 새면 연락해라고 했는데 3주동안 그런 일은 없었습니다.- 간단한 설명 및 조작방법을 알려주셨습니다.- LG기사님은 상당히 친절하셨습니다.3. 설치후 한달 경과- 설치하자마자 미리 사다 놓은 소금1kg+물 정량을 연수통에 넣고 나무젓가락으로 저어줬습니다.- 첫 가동전 식초를 활용하여 통살균 작업을 했습니다.- 이제까지 10번 가동을 하였는데 세재는 개구리 세제를 썻지만 수돗물 성분인 물때가 쫌 있었습니다.- 가급적 린스는 쓰는 것을 추천합니다. 린스를 쓰니 확실히 물때가 줄었습니다.- 표준코스가 55분코스인데 종료 몇분전부터 문이 자동으로 열리고 열풍건조 없어도 충분히 잘말라있더군요.- 트루스팀기능 없이도 충분히 세척도 잘되는 것 같습니다.- 수저통에 수저 및 젓가락 수납은 충분한데 다음에 산다면 10만원 차이 정도라면 최상단에 수저 및 젓가락 식기구를 올릴 수 있는 3단으로 살 것 같습니다.- 최근모델 중 열풍건조X, 트루스팀X, 2단선반이지만 기본적인 기능은 다 갖춘 합리적인 모델인 것 같습니다.- 급하지 않으시다면 장바구니에 넣어두시다가 가격이 떨어지시면 구매하시길 바랍니다.- 왜 3대 이모님이라고 불리는지 늦게 산게 후회되네요. 잘쓰겠습니다. 감사합니다^^

The kitchen is narrow. - Because the kitchen is narrow, it was difficult to put 6 people on the sink. - I live alone, so I asked myself a lot about whether I really need more than 12 people. But I couldn't ignore the value of dishwashing time. - Among the built-in products, I chose LG, which I trust, for home appliances after considering it comprehensively compared to other large companies. - I searched "LG Objet Dishwasher Model Name Explanation" on a portal site and studied the model names. - As a one-person household, I didn't necessarily need hot air drying, True Steam, and storage space up to 3 levels. - After studying, DUBJ1EP was a reasonable choice for me. - All the home appliances are LG, and it was good because it was an officially certified store that I could trust for installation and after-sales service. - I live in Busan, so I applied for delivery on January 13th (Sat) and the technician visited on January 15th (Mon). 2. Installation day. - One technician came. I took pictures with the permission of the technician. He said that I could show my face. - The installation cost was free when installed in a standard cabinet. - I had never used the oven in the 7 years since I moved into the house, and since the oven space was standard, I wanted to install it there. - I thought I could separate the oven and the drawer below and remove it, but I didn't know that the standard cabinet would be removed as a whole. - I am keeping the standard cabinet and oven separately so that I can restore it to its original state when I move. - I regret that I should have installed the dishwasher earlier if I knew this would happen. - Next, I leveled the dishwasher and connected the water pipe under the sink. - I told him to contact me if water leaked from the water pipe, but it didn't happen for 3 weeks. - He gave me a simple explanation and instructions on how to use it. - The LG technician was very kind. 3. One month after installation. - As soon as I installed it, I put 1kg of salt and the amount of water that I had purchased in advance into a water softener and stirred it with wooden chopsticks. - I used vinegar to sterilize the entire unit before the first operation. - I've used it 10 times so far, and although I used frog detergent, there were still some water stains from tap water. - I recommend using a rinse if possible. The water stains have definitely decreased since I used a rinse. - The standard course is a 55-minute course, but the door opens automatically a few minutes before the end, and it dries well enough even without the hot air drying function. - It seems to clean well enough even without the true steam function. - There is enough storage for spoons and chopsticks in the spoon holder, but if I buy it again, I think I'll buy a 3-tier model that can hold spoons and chopsticks on the top if there's a difference of about 100,000 won. - It's a reasonable model with all the basic functions, although it's not a hot air drying model, true steam model, or a 2-tier shelf among the latest models. - If you're not in a hurry, put it in your cart and buy it when the price drops. - I regret buying it late because I don't know why it's called the 3rd generation aunt. I'll use it well. Thank you^^
Comments (Original): *1월13일 구매후 10번 작동후 쓰는 후기입니다.1. 구입전 상황- 1인 남성 가구입니다. 주방이 좁습니다. - 주방이 좁은 관계로 6인용을 싱크대에 올리기에는 무리가 있었습니다.- 혼자사는데 굳이 12인 이상이 필요한가에 자문을 많이 했지만  설거지하는 시간의 가치를 무시할 순 없었습니다.- 빌트인 제품 중 다른 대기업보다 종합적으로 고려해서 가전은 역시 믿음의 LG를 선택했습니다.-  포털사이트에 'LG 오브제 식기세척기 모델명 풀어보기'를 검색 후 모델명을 공부했습니다.- 1인가구로 굳이 열풍건조, 트루스팀, 수납공간이 3단까지는 필요없었습니다.- 공부를 해보니 DUBJ1EP가 저에겐 합리적 선택이었습니다.- 집에 가전은 모두 LG인데 설치 및 사후관리 부분에서도 믿음이 가는 공식인증점이라서 좋았습니다.- 부산인데 1/13(토) 배송을 신청했고 1/15(월) 기사님이 방문하셨습니다.2. 설치하는 날 -기사님1분이 오셨습니다. 기사님의 동의를 얻어 사진촬영을 하였습니다. 얼굴이 나와도 된다고 하더군요.-규격장 자리에 설치시 설치비용은 무료였습니다.-집에 오븐을 입주후 7년동안 한번도 쓰지않았고 오븐자리만 규격장이라 거기에 설치하려했습니다.-오븐 및 밑에 서랍장을 분리해서 탈거할 줄 알았는데 규격장 통째로 탈거될지 몰랐습니다.-자가지만 차후 이사시 원상복귀해줄려고 규격장 및 오븐은 따로 보관중입니다.-이럴줄 알았으면 진작 식기세척기를 설치했어야 했는데 라는 아쉬움이 남았습니다.-그 다음 식기세척기 수평을 맞추고 싱크대 아래의 급수관을 연결했습니다.-차후 급수관에서 물이 새면 연락해라고 했는데 3주동안 그런 일은 없었습니다.- 간단한 설명 및 조작방법을 알려주셨습니다.- LG기사님은 상당히 친절하셨습니다.3. 설치후 한달 경과- 설치하자마자 미리 사다 놓은 소금1kg+물 정량을 연수통에 넣고 나무젓가락으로 저어줬습니다.- 첫 가동전 식초를 활용하여 통살균 작업을 했습니다.- 이제까지 10번 가동을 하였는데 세재는 개구리 세제를 썻지만 수돗물 성분인 물때가 쫌 있었습니다.- 가급적 린스는 쓰는 것을 추천합니다. 린스를 쓰니 확실히 물때가 줄었습니다.- 표준코스가 55분코스인데 종료 몇분전부터 문이 자동으로 열리고 열풍건조 없어도 충분히 잘말라있더군요.- 트루스팀기능 없이도 충분히 세척도 잘되는 것 같습니다.- 수저통에 수저 및 젓가락 수납은 충분한데 다음에 산다면 10만원 차이 정도라면 최상단에 수저 및 젓가락 식기구를 올릴 수 있는 3단으로 살 것 같습니다.- 최근모델 중 열풍건조X, 트루스팀X, 2단선반이지만 기본적인 기능은 다 갖춘 합리적인 모델인 것 같습니다.- 급하지 않으시다면 장바구니에 넣어두시다가 가격이 떨어지시면 구매하시길 바랍니다.- 왜 3대 이모님이라고 불리는지 늦게 산게 후회되네요. 잘쓰겠습니다. 감사합니다^^

Comments (English): *This is a review written after using it 10 times since purchasing it on January 13th. 1. Before purchase. - It is a one-person household. The kitchen is narrow. - Because the kitchen is narrow, it was difficult to put 6 people on the sink. - I live alone, so I asked myself a lot about whether I really need more than 12 people. But I couldn't ignore the value of dishwashing time. - Among the built-in products, I chose LG, which I trust, for home appliances after considering it comprehensively compared to other large companies. - I searched "LG Objet Dishwasher Model Name Explanation" on a portal site and studied the model names. - As a one-person household, I didn't necessarily need hot air drying, True Steam, and storage space up to 3 levels. - After studying, DUBJ1EP was a reasonable choice for me. - All the home appliances are LG, and it was good because it was an officially certified store that I could trust for installation and after-sales service. - I live in Busan, so I applied for delivery on January 13th (Sat) and the technician visited on January 15th (Mon). 2. Installation day. - One technician came. I took pictures with the permission of the technician. He said that I could show my face. - The installation cost was free when installed in a standard cabinet. - I had never used the oven in the 7 years since I moved into the house, and since the oven space was standard, I wanted to install it there. - I thought I could separate the oven and the drawer below and remove it, but I didn't know that the standard cabinet would be removed as a whole. - I am keeping the standard cabinet and oven separately so that I can restore it to its original state when I move. - I regret that I should have installed the dishwasher earlier if I knew this would happen. - Next, I leveled the dishwasher and connected the water pipe under the sink. - I told him to contact me if water leaked from the water pipe, but it didn't happen for 3 weeks. - He gave me a simple explanation and instructions on how to use it. - The LG technician was very kind. 3. One month after installation. - As soon as I installed it, I put 1kg of salt and the amount of water that I had purchased in advance into a water softener and stirred it with wooden chopsticks. - I used vinegar to sterilize the entire unit before the first operation. - I've used it 10 times so far, and although I used frog detergent, there were still some water stains from tap water. - I recommend using a rinse if possible. The water stains have definitely decreased since I used a rinse. - The standard course is a 55-minute course, but the door opens automatically a few minutes before the end, and it dries well enough even without the hot air drying function. - It seems to clean well enough even without the true steam function. - There is enough storage for spoons and chopsticks in the spoon holder, but if I buy it again, I think I'll buy a 3-tier model that can hold spoons and chopsticks on the top if there's a difference of about 100,000 won. - It's a reasonable model with all the basic functions, although it's not a hot air drying model, true steam model, or a 2-tier shelf among the latest models. - If you're not in a hurry, put it in your cart and buy it when the price drops. - I regret buying it late because I don't know why it's called the 3rd generation aunt. I'll use it well. Thank you^^

But I couldn't ignore the value of dishwashing time. - Among the built-in products, I chose LG, which I trust, for home appliances after considering it comprehensively compared to other large companies. - I searched "LG Objet Dishwasher Model Name Explanation" on a portal site and studied the model names. - As a one-person household, I didn't necessarily need hot air drying, True Steam, and storage space up to 3 levels. - After studying, DUBJ1EP was a reasonable choice for me. - All the home appliances are LG, and it was good because it was an officially certified store that I could trust for installation and after-sales service. - I live in Busan, so I applied for delivery on January 13th (Sat) and the technician visited on January 15th (Mon). 2. Installation day. - One technician came. I took pictures with the permission of the technician. He said that I could show my face. - The installation cost was free when installed in a standard cabinet. - I had never used the oven in the 7 years since I moved into the house, and since the oven space was standard, I wanted to install it there. - I thought I could separate the oven and the drawer below and remove it, but I didn't know that the standard cabinet would be removed as a whole. - I am keeping the standard cabinet and oven separately so that I can restore it to its original state when I move. - I regret that I should have installed the dishwasher earlier if I knew this would happen. - Next, I leveled the dishwasher and connected the water pipe under the sink. - I told him to contact me if water leaked from the water pipe, but it didn't happen for 3 weeks. - He gave me a simple explanation and instructions on how to use it. - The LG technician was very kind. 3. One month after installation. - As soon as I installed it, I put 1kg of salt and the amount of water that I had purchased in advance into a water softener and stirred it with wooden chopsticks. - I used vinegar to sterilize the entire unit before the first operation. - I've used it 10 times so far, and although I used frog detergent, there were still some water stains from tap water. - I recommend using a rinse if possible. The water stains have definitely decreased since I used a rinse. - The standard course is a 55-minute course, but the door opens automatically a few minutes before the end, and it dries well enough even without the hot air drying function. - It seems to clean well enough even without the true steam function. - There is enough storage for spoons and chopsticks in the spoon holder, but if I buy it again, I think I'll buy a 3-tier model that can hold spoons and chopsticks on the top if there's a difference of about 100,000 won. - It's a reasonable model with all the basic functions, although it's not a hot air drying model, true steam model, or a 2-tier shelf among the latest models. - If you're not in a hurry, put it in your cart and buy it when the price drops. - I regret buying it late because I don't know why it's called the 3rd generation aunt. I'll use it well. Thank you^^
Comments (Original): *1월13일 구매후 10번 작동후 쓰는 후기입니다.1. 구입전 상황- 1인 남성 가구입니다. 주방이 좁습니다. - 주방이 좁은 관계로 6인용을 싱크대에 올리기에는 무리가 있었습니다.- 혼자사는데 굳이 12인 이상이 필요한가에 자문을 많이 했지만  설거지하는 시간의 가치를 무시할 순 없었습니다.- 빌트인 제품 중 다른 대기업보다 종합적으로 고려해서 가전은 역시 믿음의 LG를 선택했습니다.-  포털사이트에 'LG 오브제 식기세척기 모델명 풀어보기'를 검색 후 모델명을 공부했습니다.- 1인가구로 굳이 열풍건조, 트루스팀, 수납공간이 3단까지는 필요없었습니다.- 공부를 해보니 DUBJ1EP가 저에겐 합리적 선택이었습니다.- 집에 가전은 모두 LG인데 설치 및 사후관리 부분에서도 믿음이 가는 공식인증점이라서 좋았습니다.- 부산인데 1/13(토) 배송을 신청했고 1/15(월) 기사님이 방문하셨습니다.2. 설치하는 날 -기사님1분이 오셨습니다. 기사님의 동의를 얻어 사진촬영을 하였습니다. 얼굴이 나와도 된다고 하더군요.-규격장 자리에 설치시 설치비용은 무료였습니다.-집에 오븐을 입주후 7년동안 한번도 쓰지않았고 오븐자리만 규격장이라 거기에 설치하려했습니다.-오븐 및 밑에 서랍장을 분리해서 탈거할 줄 알았는데 규격장 통째로 탈거될지 몰랐습니다.-자가지만 차후 이사시 원상복귀해줄려고 규격장 및 오븐은 따로 보관중입니다.-이럴줄 알았으면 진작 식기세척기를 설치했어야 했는데 라는 아쉬움이 남았습니다.-그 다음 식기세척기 수평을 맞추고 싱크대 아래의 급수관을 연결했습니다.-차후 급수관에서 물이 새면 연락해라고 했는데 3주동안 그런 일은 없었습니다.- 간단한 설명 및 조작방법을 알려주셨습니다.- LG기사님은 상당히 친절하셨습니다.3. 설치후 한달 경과- 설치하자마자 미리 사다 놓은 소금1kg+물 정량을 연수통에 넣고 나무젓가락으로 저어줬습니다.- 첫 가동전 식초를 활용하여 통살균 작업을 했습니다.- 이제까지 10번 가동을 하였는데 세재는 개구리 세제를 썻지만 수돗물 성분인 물때가 쫌 있었습니다.- 가급적 린스는 쓰는 것을 추천합니다. 린스를 쓰니 확실히 물때가 줄었습니다.- 표준코스가 55분코스인데 종료 몇분전부터 문이 자동으로 열리고 열풍건조 없어도 충분히 잘말라있더군요.- 트루스팀기능 없이도 충분히 세척도 잘되는 것 같습니다.- 수저통에 수저 및 젓가락 수납은 충분한데 다음에 산다면 10만원 차이 정도라면 최상단에 수저 및 젓가락 식기구를 올릴 수 있는 3단으로 살 것 같습니다.- 최근모델 중 열풍건조X, 트루스팀X, 2단선반이지만 기본적인 기능은 다 갖춘 합리적인 모델인 것 같습니다.- 급하지 않으시다면 장바구니에 넣어두시다가 가격이 떨어지시면 구매하시길 바랍니다.- 왜 3대 이모님이라고 불리는지 늦게 산게 후회되네요. 잘쓰겠습니다. 감사합니다^^

Comments (English): *This is a review written after using it 10 times since purchasing it on January 13th. 1. Before purchase. - It is a one-person household. The kitchen is narrow. - Because the kitchen is narrow, it was difficult to put 6 people on the sink. - I live alone, so I asked myself a lot about whether I really need more than 12 people. But I couldn't ignore the value of dishwashing time. - Among the built-in products, I chose LG, which I trust, for home appliances after considering it comprehensively compared to other large companies. - I searched "LG Objet Dishwasher Model Name Explanation" on a portal site and studied the model names. - As a one-person household, I didn't necessarily need hot air drying, True Steam, and storage space up to 3 levels. - After studying, DUBJ1EP was a reasonable choice for me. - All the home appliances are LG, and it was good because it was an officially certified store that I could trust for installation and after-sales service. - I live in Busan, so I applied for delivery on January 13th (Sat) and the technician visited on January 15th (Mon). 2. Installation day. - One technician came. I took pictures with the permission of the technician. He said that I could show my face. - The installation cost was free when installed in a standard cabinet. - I had never used the oven in the 7 years since I moved into the house, and since the oven space was standard, I wanted to install it there. - I thought I could separate the oven and the drawer below and remove it, but I didn't know that the standard cabinet would be removed as a whole. - I am keeping the standard cabinet and oven separately so that I can restore it to its original state when I move. - I regret that I should have installed the dishwasher earlier if I knew this would happen. - Next, I leveled the dishwasher and connected the water pipe under the sink. - I told him to contact me if water leaked from the water pipe, but it didn't happen for 3 weeks. - He gave me a simple explanation and instructions on how to use it. - The LG technician was very kind. 3. One month after installation. - As soon as I installed it, I put 1kg of salt and the amount of water that I had purchased in advance into a water softener and stirred it with wooden chopsticks. - I used vinegar to sterilize the entire unit before the first operation. - I've used it 10 times so far, and although I used frog detergent, there were still some water stains from tap water. - I recommend using a rinse if possible. The water stains have definitely decreased since I used a rinse. - The standard course is a 55-minute course, but the door opens automatically a few minutes before the end, and it dries well enough even without the hot air drying function. - It seems to clean well enough even without the true steam function. - There is enough storage for spoons and chopsticks in the spoon holder, but if I buy it again, I think I'll buy a 3-tier model that can hold spoons and chopsticks on the top if there's a difference of about 100,000 won. - It's a reasonable model with all the basic functions, although it's not a hot air drying model, true steam model, or a 2-tier shelf among the latest models. - If you're not in a hurry, put it in your cart and buy it when the price drops. - I regret buying it late because I don't know why it's called the 3rd generation aunt. I'll use it well. Thank you^^

Comments (English): *This is a review written after using it 10 times since purchasing it on January 13th. 1. Before purchase. - It is a one-person household. The kitchen is narrow. - Because the kitchen is narrow, it was difficult to put 6 people on the sink. - I live alone, so I asked myself a lot about whether I really need more than 12 people. But I couldn't ignore the value of dishwashing time. - Among the built-in products, I chose LG, which I trust, for home appliances after considering it comprehensively compared to other large companies. - I searched "LG Objet Dishwasher Model Name Explanation" on a portal site and studied the model names. - As a one-person household, I didn't necessarily need hot air drying, True Steam, and storage space up to 3 levels. - After studying, DUBJ1EP was a reasonable choice for me. - All the home appliances are LG, and it was good because it was an officially certified store that I could trust for installation and after-sales service. - I live in Busan, so I applied for delivery on January 13th (Sat) and the technician visited on January 15th (Mon). 2. Installation day. - One technician came. I took pictures with the permission of the technician. He said that I could show my face. - The installation cost was free when installed in a standard cabinet. - I had never used the oven in the 7 years since I moved into the house, and since the oven space was standard, I wanted to install it there. - I thought I could separate the oven and the drawer below and remove it, but I didn't know that the standard cabinet would be removed as a whole. - I am keeping the standard cabinet and oven separately so that I can restore it to its original state when I move. - I regret that I should have installed the dishwasher earlier if I knew this would happen. - Next, I leveled the dishwasher and connected the water pipe under the sink. - I told him to contact me if water leaked from the water pipe, but it didn't happen for 3 weeks. - He gave me a simple explanation and instructions on how to use it. - The LG technician was very kind. 3. One month after installation. - As soon as I installed it, I put 1kg of salt and the amount of water that I had purchased in advance into a water softener and stirred it with wooden chopsticks. - I used vinegar to sterilize the entire unit before the first operation. - I've used it 10 times so far, and although I used frog detergent, there were still some water stains from tap water. - I recommend using a rinse if possible. The water stains have definitely decreased since I used a rinse. - The standard course is a 55-minute course, but the door opens automatically a few minutes before the end, and it dries well enough even without the hot air drying function. - It seems to clean well enough even without the true steam function. - There is enough storage for spoons and chopsticks in the spoon holder, but if I buy it again, I think I'll buy a 3-tier model that can hold spoons and chopsticks on the top if there's a difference of about 100,000 won. - It's a reasonable model with all the basic functions, although it's not a hot air drying model, true steam model, or a 2-tier shelf among the latest models. - If you're not in a hurry, put it in your cart and buy it when the price drops. - I regret buying it late because I don't know why it's called the 3rd generation aunt. I'll use it well. Thank you^^

But I couldn't ignore the value of dishwashing time. - Among the built-in products, I chose LG, which I trust, for home appliances after considering it comprehensively compared to other large companies. - I searched "LG Objet Dishwasher Model Name Explanation" on a portal site and studied the model names. - As a one-person household, I didn't necessarily need hot air drying, True Steam, and storage space up to 3 levels. - After studying, DUBJ1EP was a reasonable choice for me. - All the home appliances are LG, and it was good because it was an officially certified store that I could trust for installation and after-sales service. - I live in Busan, so I applied for delivery on January 13th (Sat) and the technician visited on January 15th (Mon). 2. Installation day. - One technician came. I took pictures with the permission of the technician. He said that I could show my face. - The installation cost was free when installed in a standard cabinet. - I had never used the oven in the 7 years since I moved into the house, and since the oven space was standard, I wanted to install it there. - I thought I could separate the oven and the drawer below and remove it, but I didn't know that the standard cabinet would be removed as a whole. - I am keeping the standard cabinet and oven separately so that I can restore it to its original state when I move. - I regret that I should have installed the dishwasher earlier if I knew this would happen. - Next, I leveled the dishwasher and connected the water pipe under the sink. - I told him to contact me if water leaked from the water pipe, but it didn't happen for 3 weeks. - He gave me a simple explanation and instructions on how to use it. - The LG technician was very kind. 3. One month after installation. - As soon as I installed it, I put 1kg of salt and the amount of water that I had purchased in advance into a water softener and stirred it with wooden chopsticks. - I used vinegar to sterilize the entire unit before the first operation. - I've used it 10 times so far, and although I used frog detergent, there were still some water stains from tap water. - I recommend using a rinse if possible. The water stains have definitely decreased since I used a rinse. - The standard course is a 55-minute course, but the door opens automatically a few minutes before the end, and it dries well enough even without the hot air drying function. - It seems to clean well enough even without the true steam function. - There is enough storage for spoons and chopsticks in the spoon holder, but if I buy it again, I think I'll buy a 3-tier model that can hold spoons and chopsticks on the top if there's a difference of about 100,000 won. - It's a reasonable model with all the basic functions, although it's not a hot air drying model, true steam model, or a 2-tier shelf among the latest models. - If you're not in a hurry, put it in your cart and buy it when the price drops. - I regret buying it late because I don't know why it's called the 3rd generation aunt. I'll use it well. Thank you^^
Comments (Original): *1월13일 구매후 10번 작동후 쓰는 후기입니다.1. 구입전 상황- 1인 남성 가구입니다. 주방이 좁습니다. - 주방이 좁은 관계로 6인용을 싱크대에 올리기에는 무리가 있었습니다.- 혼자사는데 굳이 12인 이상이 필요한가에 자문을 많이 했지만  설거지하는 시간의 가치를 무시할 순 없었습니다.- 빌트인 제품 중 다른 대기업보다 종합적으로 고려해서 가전은 역시 믿음의 LG를 선택했습니다.-  포털사이트에 'LG 오브제 식기세척기 모델명 풀어보기'를 검색 후 모델명을 공부했습니다.- 1인가구로 굳이 열풍건조, 트루스팀, 수납공간이 3단까지는 필요없었습니다.- 공부를 해보니 DUBJ1EP가 저에겐 합리적 선택이었습니다.- 집에 가전은 모두 LG인데 설치 및 사후관리 부분에서도 믿음이 가는 공식인증점이라서 좋았습니다.- 부산인데 1/13(토) 배송을 신청했고 1/15(월) 기사님이 방문하셨습니다.2. 설치하는 날 -기사님1분이 오셨습니다. 기사님의 동의를 얻어 사진촬영을 하였습니다. 얼굴이 나와도 된다고 하더군요.-규격장 자리에 설치시 설치비용은 무료였습니다.-집에 오븐을 입주후 7년동안 한번도 쓰지않았고 오븐자리만 규격장이라 거기에 설치하려했습니다.-오븐 및 밑에 서랍장을 분리해서 탈거할 줄 알았는데 규격장 통째로 탈거될지 몰랐습니다.-자가지만 차후 이사시 원상복귀해줄려고 규격장 및 오븐은 따로 보관중입니다.-이럴줄 알았으면 진작 식기세척기를 설치했어야 했는데 라는 아쉬움이 남았습니다.-그 다음 식기세척기 수평을 맞추고 싱크대 아래의 급수관을 연결했습니다.-차후 급수관에서 물이 새면 연락해라고 했는데 3주동안 그런 일은 없었습니다.- 간단한 설명 및 조작방법을 알려주셨습니다.- LG기사님은 상당히 친절하셨습니다.3. 설치후 한달 경과- 설치하자마자 미리 사다 놓은 소금1kg+물 정량을 연수통에 넣고 나무젓가락으로 저어줬습니다.- 첫 가동전 식초를 활용하여 통살균 작업을 했습니다.- 이제까지 10번 가동을 하였는데 세재는 개구리 세제를 썻지만 수돗물 성분인 물때가 쫌 있었습니다.- 가급적 린스는 쓰는 것을 추천합니다. 린스를 쓰니 확실히 물때가 줄었습니다.- 표준코스가 55분코스인데 종료 몇분전부터 문이 자동으로 열리고 열풍건조 없어도 충분히 잘말라있더군요.- 트루스팀기능 없이도 충분히 세척도 잘되는 것 같습니다.- 수저통에 수저 및 젓가락 수납은 충분한데 다음에 산다면 10만원 차이 정도라면 최상단에 수저 및 젓가락 식기구를 올릴 수 있는 3단으로 살 것 같습니다.- 최근모델 중 열풍건조X, 트루스팀X, 2단선반이지만 기본적인 기능은 다 갖춘 합리적인 모델인 것 같습니다.- 급하지 않으시다면 장바구니에 넣어두시다가 가격이 떨어지시면 구매하시길 바랍니다.- 왜 3대 이모님이라고 불리는지 늦게 산게 후회되네요. 잘쓰겠습니다. 감사합니다^^
