Comments (English): *This is a review written after using it 10 times since purchasing it on January 13th. 1. Before purchase. - It is a one-person household. The kitchen is narrow. - Because the kitchen is narrow, it was difficult to put 6 people on the sink. - I live alone, so I asked myself a lot about whether I really need more than 12 people. But I couldn't ignore the value of dishwashing time. - Among the built-in products, I chose LG, which I trust, for home appliances after considering it comprehensively compared to other large companies. - I searched "LG Objet Dishwasher Model Name Explanation" on a portal site and studied the model names. - As a one-person household, I didn't necessarily need hot air drying, True Steam, and storage space up to 3 levels. - After studying, DUBJ1EP was a reasonable choice for me. - All the home appliances are LG, and it was good because it was an officially certified store that I could trust for installation and after-sales service. - I live in Busan, so I applied for delivery on January 13th (Sat) and the technician visited on January 15th (Mon). 2. Installation day. - One technician came. I took pictures with the permission of the technician. He said that I could show my face. - The installation cost was free when installed in a standard cabinet. - I had never used the oven in the 7 years since I moved into the house, and since the oven space was standard, I wanted to install it there. - I thought I could separate the oven and the drawer below and remove it, but I didn't know that the standard cabinet would be removed as a whole. - I am keeping the standard cabinet and oven separately so that I can restore it to its original state when I move. - I regret that I should have installed the dishwasher earlier if I knew this would happen. - Next, I leveled the dishwasher and connected the water pipe under the sink. - I told him to contact me if water leaked from the water pipe, but it didn't happen for 3 weeks. - He gave me a simple explanation and instructions on how to use it. - The LG technician was very kind. 3. One month after installation. - As soon as I installed it, I put 1kg of salt and the amount of water that I had purchased in advance into a water softener and stirred it with wooden chopsticks. - I used vinegar to sterilize the entire unit before the first operation. - I've used it 10 times so far, and although I used frog detergent, there were still some water stains from tap water. - I recommend using a rinse if possible. The water stains have definitely decreased since I used a rinse. - The standard course is a 55-minute course, but the door opens automatically a few minutes before the end, and it dries well enough even without the hot air drying function. - It seems to clean well enough even without the true steam function. - There is enough storage for spoons and chopsticks in the spoon holder, but if I buy it again, I think I'll buy a 3-tier model that can hold spoons and chopsticks on the top if there's a difference of about 100,000 won. - It's a reasonable model with all the basic functions, although it's not a hot air drying model, true steam model, or a 2-tier shelf among the latest models. - If you're not in a hurry, put it in your cart and buy it when the price drops. - I regret buying it late because I don't know why it's called the 3rd generation aunt. I'll use it well. Thank you^^

May 5, 2024. Review after three months of actual use. It’s so good; my quality of life has skyrocketed. I’ve also updated with another photo. When I wrote my previous review, I realized I hadn't mentioned the feature I considered when buying this product compared to other 6-place dishwashers! It is the 'automatic door opening.' Other 6-place models don't have this feature. I am using it very well without any regrets. My first purchase review written in February 2024. I deliberated for over a month before buying this product. Since all the appliances in my house were LG products, I had never used a Samsung product before. Because my job requires me to move frequently, even if I were to buy a 12-place or larger model, I was only looking for one that could be used as a freestanding unit. After doing a lot of research, I ended up purchasing this product. The main reasons for purchasing this product are as follows. On the day I attached the photo, there weren't many dishes, so it looks like I just threw them in haphazardly (wooden dishes aren't supposed to be used, but I just throw them in and use it). First, is the interior wall material stainless steel? - I watched a YouTube video by someone who reviews appliances while wearing a bear costume. They compared several small dishwashers and specifically compared whether the interior walls were made of plastic or stainless steel. They mentioned that the interior wall material affects drying and humidity. I purchased this product because three sides are stainless steel. Second, a situation where I cannot install the dishwasher by drilling holes. - My job requires me to move frequently, so having a technician come every time for relocation is inconvenient (although it seems like I could install it myself if I understood the principle), and there are cost issues. Also, I am in a situation where I absolutely cannot drill holes. Third, difficulty bending my back due to a herniated disc. - I was recently diagnosed with a herniated disc and am currently wearing a back brace; the fact that I would have to bend over to use a large-capacity dishwasher was a burden. Fourth, as a family of two, the amount of dishes to wash is not large. - It would be different if I had a large family with a lot of dishes to wash, but since we are a two-person household, the amount of dishes for lunch and dinner isn't usually heavy. Except for the occasional use of large pots or pans, I can wash two meals for two in one go. Fifth, by nature, I cannot let things pile up and wash them all at once. - If it were a large dishwasher, I could have done the dishes all at once for a day or two, but since I don't tend to let things accumulate anyway, I run it immediately. On days when there is a lot of dishes for a single meal, I sometimes run it twice, once for lunch and once for dinner. Since I enjoy cooking, I used to get very stressed and exhausted worrying about washing dishes after meals; I would soak (and clean) them right after eating. However, now I can clean leisurely after meals, and since the dishes wash very well even when placed directly without soaking, I feel much more at ease. As you can see in the video, the door opens automatically when there are about 4 minutes remaining after both washing and drying are complete, allowing for almost perfect drying. My mother had been skeptical about dishwashers and hadn't used one for a long time, but after hearing my experience, she decided to buy one. I also regretted not buying it sooner, thinking I should have gotten one right after getting married. The controls are intuitive, making it easy and convenient to use. Even disposable containers heavily stained with chili oil from delivery food come out squeaky white, looking brand new! This is a 100% honest review.

Sentence (English): Received my new dishwasher replacement for an old GE with bottle washers.
Comments (English): [ GE quality ] || ---------------- || Received my new dishwasher replacement for an old GE with bottle washers. New one is upgraded on the bottle washers as the old version had red caps that would clog and were difficult to clear. This one also has the third rack which is extremely useful. Disappointed that it doesn't have the old adjustable tines on the lower rack or the stemware racks. So I transferred my old stemware racks to the new machine. Lower rack is not transferable due to the new design. Silverware jets under the rack is awesome. Foldable tines are not a deal breaker but were used occasionally on the old machine. The door is greatly improved with controls sealed and more durable. The old machine buttons would hang up/stick down. Door feels kinda cheap and or weak but is lighter and I'm sure is more durable and effective. Installing was identical to the old one but no door spring adjustment. Wish the feet were thicker to accommodate a wrench better. Overall very happy with the new design wish they offered more add on options like the stemware racks for people who are purchasing for the first time. I saved usable parts from the old machine and with the transferred stemware racks it's an awesome □□ machine.

Sentence (English): My wife and I give this five stars for cleaning.
Comments (English): [ Cleans great, loading takes some thought ] || ---------------- || My wife and I give this five stars for cleaning. It does a fantastic job, even on dishes we never expected to get clean. We are still challenged when it comes to loading it up. The specs say it will accommodate a 16-piece place setting, and we believe this, but who eats with formal place settings? We have microwaveable bowls and reheatable containers that just don't fit the profile of items the Bosch was designed to accommodate. Our older dishwasher did a much better job holding an assortment of odd-shaped bowls and containers. Don't get me wrong, we can find places for these items in the Bosch, but because of the tine positioning, it holds much less than our older Kitchen Aide, so we give it 3.5 stars in this area. The 3rd tray raised from 3 to 3.5. As for noise, it gets six stars - sometimes, we have trouble knowing it's actually working. Drying - I've read many complaints about this. We find it adequate but not excellent. Plastic items tend to stay wet, but glass, metal, and ceramic come out dry. We wish we knew when it was entering the dry cycle. In the winter, here in Ohio, we need the humidity. We like to open the door to air dry. In the summer, we will let it run its full cycle. Bosch Connect - we only own this Bosch product, so Bosch Connect is fairly useless. We weren't expecting much, and it didn't disappoint!

Sentence (English): Overall this dishwasher is pretty good, though we were very excited about the automatic opening function to help everything dry and it does not work as well as we had hoped.
Comments (English): [ Not as Good as Our Old Bosch Dishwasher ] || ---------------- || Overall this dishwasher is pretty good, though we were very excited about the automatic opening function to help everything dry and it does not work as well as we had hoped. It cleans well and it was easy to install, I did it myself without any trouble. Regarding the automatic opening, plastic items or coffee mugs with larger puddles on the bottom do not dry fully, even when left overnight. Frustratingly the dishwasher delays an hour after the wash cycle is over before opening the door, which wastes the time when everything is the hottest and the water would be most likely to evaporate. This dishwasher is also louder than our 20 year old Bosh dishwasher that we had before. If this one is loaded perfectly then it is silent; but no one ever loads their dishwasher perfectly. Sadly something about how the racks are designed or how the water is squirted makes it more likely for things in the dishwasher to bump against each other. This results in a lot more: thunk, thunk sounds which are much more noticeable compared to our old model. We haven't noticed anything damaged yet, nor have we noticed that this newer model is better at cleaning than our old one. My last issue is the start button. Obviously you have to press the start button to run the dishwasher, that's fine. However if you open the dishwasher when it's running or when it's on a delayed start, you have to press the start button again before closing the door. This may seem obvious, but in reality it leads to half done loads or loads that never ran at all. Particularly with the delayed start someone thinks that they have set the dishwasher to run, they have completed that task. Another person comes along to put a cup or something they found in the living room in the dishwasher, and they don't realize that it was set to run. For them, they opened the dishwasher it wasn't running, so they just put the cup in and there's no reason for them to press Start. Even if you open the dishwasher when it's running, your instinct is to correct your error as quickly as possible and close the door, not press Start again. It seems obvious that it was running, the vast majority of the time when you open the door mid cycle it's a mistake and closing the door right away seems like a good obvious indication of that. Again with our old Bosch dishwasher if you opened it mid wash, realized your mistake and closed it again, it would just continue washing.

Sentence (English): This is the absolute worst dishwasher I've ever had and I just got rid of a Maytag that literally fell apart in the first year.
Comments (English): [ Louder than countertop dishwasher and the smel!  ] || ---------------- || This is the absolute worst dishwasher I've ever had and I just got rid of a Maytag that literally fell apart in the first year. I've been without a dishwasher for years and finally decided to break down and get one. Choosing this one was a huge mistake. This GE is the cheapest made appliance I've ever seen. It feels flimsy at best. It feels like if you actually use it, it will fall apart. I've never seen an appliance this poorly or cheaply made. Everything is super lightweight and feels like it is going to fall apart. Nothing in it functions like you would expect a dishwasher of any price to work. The racks don't slide evenly, it doesn't close smoothly, it is just so cheaply made. Unfortunately, they get you because they know that trying to return an appliance that is literally built in is a lot of times more trouble than it is worth and people will just try to deal with the terrible product instead of the returns process. This dishwasher is louder than the little countertop dishwasher I've been using for the past year. My reason for finally replacing the built in was because of the noise level of the countertop and it tied up my sink, but this thing exceeds that that noise level. It is so loud it is unbearable and the cycles are so long there is no getting away from it. We've made sure the insulation is in place properly, made sure it is all done right, this dishwasher is just super loud and ear numbing. That would be livable if it had a delayed wash cycle so it could be run overnight, but it doesn't. In an open concept home this is a nightmare. Then you have the smell. Anything new has a manufacturers smell, but after airing out it usually goes away. This appliance the smell stays. It is awful and overpowering and gets into everything. I ran empty loads for days with just baking soda or baking soda and detergent and nothing. After 2 weeks of multiple runs a day like this, I finally put pots in there for a couple of days that I had used to cook garlic and onions. After multiple cycles of that and 2 weeks later, the smell has lessened enough that we can actually use it for dishes. However, you cannot run it over night (to avoid the noise) and let the dishes sit in it or the smell still will seep into them. This product is awful. I predict we will have to replace it in a year or less based on its fragility and inability to really do much of anything other than fill a space. A total disappointment and not worth it.

I saved usable parts from the old machine and with the transferred stemware racks it's an awesome machine.

Sentence (English): In use for over a month, so far so good.
Comments (English): [ much more pros than cons ] || ---------------- || In use for over a month, so far so good. Very quiet to the point you check to see if it's running but does a great job. Surprised it did not come with a glass stem holder that less expensive models have. Racks seem well designed to accept various shaped dishes and pans at least the ones we have. Installation was relatively easy but the unit is lower to the floor than previous models which makes it very difficult to move into place if using copper tubing as a water supply. Since the inlet is plastic, I used the flex hose as it felt like copper tubing was putting too much strain on plastic inlet. The plastic inlet does concern me as a failure means an uncontrolled flood which is reason for 4 rather than 5 stars. If bending is an issue, this unit may be harder to load on the bottom shelf as shelf is closer to floor than other models (~6" off floor) . So far, very satisfied with this unit. This unit replaced a previous Kitchenaid model that lasted over 16 years.

Sentence (English): My wife and I give this five stars for cleaning.
Comments (English): [ Cleans great, loading takes some thought ] || ---------------- || My wife and I give this five stars for cleaning. It does a fantastic job, even on dishes we never expected to get clean.We are still challenged when it comes to loading it up. The specs say it will accommodate a 16-piece place setting, and we believe this, but who eats with formal place settings? We have microwaveable bowls and reheatable containers that just don't fit the profile of items the Bosch was designed to accommodate. Our older dishwasher did a much better job holding an assortment of odd-shaped bowls and containers. Don't get me wrong, we can find places for these items in the Bosch, but because of the tine positioning, it holds much less than our older Kitchen Aide, so we give it 3.5 stars in this area. The 3rd tray raised from 3 to 3.5.As for noise, it gets six stars - sometimes, we have trouble knowing it's actually working. Drying - I've read many complaints about this. We find it adequate but not excellent. Plastic items tend to stay wet, but glass, metal, and ceramic come out dry. We wish we knew when it was entering the dry cycle. In the winter, here in Ohio, we need the humidity. We like to open the door to air dry. In the summer, we will let it run its full cycle. Bosch Connect - we only own this Bosch product, so Bosch Connect is fairly useless. We weren't expecting much, and it didn't disappoint!
